newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo May consumer prices up 1.4 pct year/year.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo May consumer prices up 1.4 pct year/year.

text.p: Tokyo area consumer prices rose 1.4 percent in May from a year earlier, while nationwide consumer prices for April rose 1.9 percent year-on-year, the government's Management and Coordination Agency said on Friday.
An agency official said the rise in the nationwide consumer price index reflected an increase in the sales tax to five percent from three percent on April 1.
He added that the 1.9 percent rise in the index was largely within expectations.
